$comment: Settings page (/settings) and its cards. Seen by every signed-in user (musicians, band leaders, admins). 'chart' = sheet music.

back.where: Settings page header: accessible name of the back-arrow button (mobile only)

subtitle.where: Settings page: grey line under the main heading

account.where: Settings page: small uppercase section heading above the profile, appearance and password cards

profilePhotoAlt.where: Settings page, account card: alt text of the user's profile photo

saveName.where: Settings page, account card: accessible name of the check-mark button that saves an edited display name

defaultDisplayName.where: Settings page, account card: shown as the user's name when they have no display name
defaultDisplayName.context: A generic noun for a band member.

role.admin.where: Settings page, account card: small badge showing the user's role
role.admin.context: Shown in capitals (English writes it in capitals).

role.bandLeader.where: Settings page, account card: role badge
role.bandLeader.context: Glossary: band leader. Shown in capitals.

role.musician.where: Settings page, account card: role badge

role.member.where: Settings page, account card: role badge (also the fallback when no role is known)

role.pending.where: Settings page, account card: role badge for a user still awaiting approval

appearance.where: Settings page: heading of the theme card

theme.light.where: Settings page, Appearance card: theme button

theme.dark.where: Settings page, Appearance card: theme button

theme.system.where: Settings page, Appearance card: theme button (follow the device setting)

gigMode.title.where: Settings page: heading of the Live Gig Mode toggle card

gigMode.description.where: Settings page, Live Gig Mode card: explanation under the heading

password.title.where: Settings page: heading of the change-password card (email/password accounts only)
password.title.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.description.where: Settings page, change-password card: line under the heading
password.description.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.current.where: Settings page, change-password card: field label
password.current.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.new.where: Settings page, change-password card: field label
password.new.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.newPlaceholder.where: Settings page, change-password card: placeholder inside the new-password field
password.newPlaceholder.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.confirm.where: Settings page, change-password card: field label
password.confirm.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.success.where: Settings page, change-password card: green confirmation box after saving
password.success.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.submit.where: Settings page, change-password card: submit button
password.submit.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.mismatch.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.mismatch.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.tooShort.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.tooShort.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.incorrect.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.incorrect.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.weak.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.weak.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.tooManyAttempts.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.tooManyAttempts.who: users who sign in with email and password

password.failed.where: Settings page, change-password card: red error box
password.failed.who: users who sign in with email and password

myInstrument.where: Settings page: small uppercase section heading above the musician profile card

integrations.where: Settings page: small uppercase section heading above the Claude / MCP access card

version.where: Settings page footer: faint build label
version.context: {version} is the app version number, {commit} a short code id; 'v' abbreviates 'version'.

mcp.title.where: Settings page, Integrations: heading of the Claude connector card
mcp.title.context: 'Claude' (an AI assistant) and 'MCP' (Model Context Protocol) are product names: keep them in Latin letters.

mcp.description.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: line under the heading
mcp.description.context: 'Claude' is a product name; keep it as is. A token is a secret access key.

mcp.loadFailed.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: error toast
mcp.loadFailed.context: MCP is a product name; keep it.

mcp.createFailed.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: error toast

mcp.copied.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: success toast after copying the new token

mcp.copyFailed.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: error toast when the clipboard is unavailable

mcp.revoked.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: success toast after deleting a token

mcp.revokeFailed.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: error toast

mcp.revealWarning.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: amber warning above a newly generated token (shown once)

mcp.copyToken.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: accessible name of the copy icon button

mcp.done.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: link that hides the newly generated token

mcp.labelPlaceholder.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: placeholder in the token name field
mcp.labelPlaceholder.context: 'Claude Desktop' is a product name; keep it as is.

mcp.generate.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: button that creates a token

mcp.loading.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: loading line

mcp.empty.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: shown when the user has no tokens

mcp.tokenDates.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: grey line under each token's name
mcp.tokenDates.context: {created} and {lastUsed} are dates (e.g. Oct 3, 2026) or a dash when unknown.

mcp.revoke.where: Settings page, Claude / MCP card: accessible name of the trash-can button on each token
mcp.revoke.context: {tokenLabel} is the name the user gave the token.

push.title.where: Settings page: heading of the push-notification toggle card

push.description.where: Settings page, push notification card: line under the heading

push.enabled.where: Settings page, push notification card: success toast

push.disabled.where: Settings page, push notification card: success toast

push.blockedToast.where: Settings page, push notification card: error toast when the browser blocks notifications

push.enableFailed.where: Settings page, push notification card: error toast

push.updateFailed.where: Settings page, push notification card: error toast

push.unsupported.where: Settings page, push notification card: shown instead of the toggle on browsers without push

push.blockedHint.where: Settings page, push notification card: amber note under the toggle when the browser blocks notifications

profile.title.where: Settings page, My Instrument: heading of the musician profile card

profile.description.where: Settings page, musician profile card: line under the heading

profile.nudge.where: Settings page, musician profile card: amber nudge shown when no instrument is chosen
profile.nudge.context: {emphasis} is replaced by the bold phrase 'automatically transposed charts' (key profile.nudgeEmphasis); place it where it reads naturally. Charts = sheet music.

profile.nudgeEmphasis.where: Settings page, musician profile card: bold phrase inside the instrument nudge sentence
profile.nudgeEmphasis.context: Inserted into profile.nudge at {emphasis}. Charts = sheet music.

profile.saved.where: Settings page, musician profile card: success toast

profile.saveFailed.where: Settings page, musician profile card: error toast
profile.saveFailed.context: {error} is a technical error message (often English) or the 'Unknown error' text.

profile.unknownError.where: Settings page, musician profile card: inserted into the save-failed toast when no error detail exists

profile.instrument.where: Settings page, musician profile card: label above the instrument buttons

profile.semitones.where: Settings page, musician profile card: small line under a transposing instrument's name
profile.semitones.context: {offset} is a signed number like +2 or -3 (the count is its absolute value). English uses 'semitones' for every number.

profile.transpositionOffset.where: Settings page, musician profile card: label above the − / + transposition stepper

profile.showCapo.where: Settings page, musician profile card: toggle label (guitar-like instruments)
profile.showCapo.context: Capo: the clamp guitarists put on the neck.

profile.defaultCapoFret.where: Settings page, musician profile card: label above the capo fret number buttons

profile.preferFlats.where: Settings page, musician profile card: toggle label
profile.preferFlats.context: Bb and A# are note names: keep them exactly as written (Latin letters).

profile.saving.where: Settings page, musician profile card: save button while saving

profile.save.where: Settings page, musician profile card: save button

instruments.acousticGuitar.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.electricBass.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.mandolin.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.electricGuitar.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.classicalGuitar.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.voice.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button (singers)

instruments.handDrums.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.violin.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.ebAltoSax.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.ebAltoSax.context: 'Eb' is the instrument's key (E-flat); keep the note name as written.

instruments.bbTenorSax.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.bbTenorSax.context: 'Bb' = B-flat; keep the note name as written.

instruments.bbSopranoSax.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.bbSopranoSax.context: 'Bb' = B-flat; keep the note name as written.

instruments.bbClarinet.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.bbClarinet.context: 'Bb' = B-flat; keep the note name as written.

instruments.bbTrumpet.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.bbTrumpet.context: 'Bb' = B-flat; keep the note name as written.

instruments.fHorn.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button
instruments.fHorn.context: (F) is the horn's key; keep the note name.

instruments.trombone.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.piano.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.ukulele.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button

instruments.other.where: Settings page, musician profile card: instrument button for anything not listed

instrumentNotes.concertPitch.where: Settings page, musician profile card: line describing the chosen instrument's transposition

instrumentNotes.concertPitchOctaveLower.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description (bass)

instrumentNotes.rhythmOnly.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description (drums)

instrumentNotes.major6thLower.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description

instrumentNotes.major9thLower.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description

instrumentNotes.wholeStepLower.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description

instrumentNotes.fifthLower.where: Settings page, musician profile card: transposition description

instrumentNotes.custom.where: Settings page, musician profile card: description for the 'Other' instrument

scheduling.title.where: Settings page, musician profile card: heading of the scheduling section

scheduling.description.where: Settings page, scheduling section: line under the heading

scheduling.phone.where: Settings page, scheduling section: phone field label

scheduling.phonePlaceholder.where: Settings page, scheduling section: example phone number inside the empty phone field
scheduling.phonePlaceholder.context: A fake sample number in the local format; replace with a local-format example.

scheduling.phoneHint.where: Settings page, scheduling section: grey note under the phone field

scheduling.notifications.where: Settings page, scheduling section: label above the Email / SMS / Push toggles

scheduling.email.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: toggle name

scheduling.emailDescription.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: grey line under the Email toggle

scheduling.sms.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: toggle name (text messages)

scheduling.smsDescription.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: grey line under the SMS toggle

scheduling.push.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: toggle name (browser/device push notifications)

scheduling.pushDescription.where: Settings page, scheduling notifications: grey line under the Push toggle

scheduling.calendarTitle.where: Settings page, scheduling section: label of the calendar feed box

scheduling.copy.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: button that copies the feed URL

scheduling.calendarCopied.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: success toast

scheduling.calendarAddHint.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: note under the feed URL
scheduling.calendarAddHint.context: Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook are product names. {community} is the community's short name. It reads 'CRC' on CRC and on Brothers Lazaroff exactly as before phase 7; other tenants get their own short name.

scheduling.calendarGenerated.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: success toast

scheduling.calendarGenerateFailed.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: error toast

scheduling.calendarGenerating.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: button text while working

scheduling.calendarGenerate.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: button that creates the feed URL

scheduling.calendarGenerateHint.where: Settings page, calendar feed box: note under the generate button
scheduling.calendarGenerateHint.context: {community} is the community's short name. It reads 'CRC' on CRC and on Brothers Lazaroff exactly as before phase 7; other tenants get their own short name.

performThemeHint.where: Settings page, Appearance card: small grey note under the theme buttons
performThemeHint.context: 'Perform mode' is the on-stage setlist and chart view. 'Dark' is the theme button label above (settings.theme.dark); use the same word.
